[Urda Town Square Center]
The former site of a fierce battle for control of this great city was waged here, and on this site is where it's citizens celebrate that victory. Statues of the fallen heroes, and great leaders of the alliance adorn the tops of grand marble archways leading in all directions. They stand ever vigilant against any unseen enemy. The people of Urda flock here to barter and trade, to converse with friends, or just relax near the fountain and have a game of chess. Benches and tables dot the landscape near the edge of the fountain. Hawkers of all type roll through this area with their wares, hoping to make a few coins. Languages of all races are spoken here. The sheer din of the crowd reverberates throughout the area. Passersby stop to admire the detail of the arches as they enter and exit the city square.

[Urda Town Square Center]
The former site of a fierce battle for control of this great city was waged here, and on this site is where it's citizens celebrate that victory. Statues of the fallen heroes, and great leaders of the alliance adorn the tops of grand marble archways leading in all directions. They stand ever vigilant against any unseen enemy. The people of Urda flock here to barter and trade, to converse with friends, or just relax near the fountain and have a game of chess. Benches and tables dot the landscape near the edge of the fountain. Hawkers of all type roll through this area with their wares, hoping to make a few coins. Languages of all races are spoken here. The sheer din of the crowd reverberates throughout the area. Passersby stop to admire the detail of the arches as they enter and exit the city square.

The area is illuminated.

The remains of a large and abandoned shed can be seen to the north of the road. The windows are shattered and not a single pane of glass remains. Someone has decorated the dilapidated building with graffiti that predominately questions birth legitimacy and the family history of those who run the town. A heavy black wooden door hangs half way off its heavy iron hinges, but is still open enough to pass through.

The area is illuminated.

Obvious exits are: west, east

[East Street]
An overgrown magnolia tree stands on the south side of the road. Huge out of control branches extend completely across the road. Their thick leaves shield both the sun and the moon from view. Several of the branches droop into the street, making passing through difficult for anything larger than a small ox cart.

The area is illuminated.

Obvious exits are: west, east

[East Street]
A large metal barrel, that someone has began using as a make shift trash can, leans up against what is left of the curb. Directly across the street from the barrel is a tall lamp post displaying a brilliantly crafted iron post and a beautifully etched glass lantern.  It stays lit throughout the day and night and it brightens the way both during the darkness and on dreary days.

The area is illuminated.

The area is illuminated.

[East Street]

[East Street]
Wild green grass grows in haphazard clumps at the side of the road. Every so often a flower of pink or purple protrudes gracefully out of the center of one of the grassy clumps. The wild flowers have a pungent scent and every so often an occasional butterfly stops to feed on their nectar.


The area is illuminated.

[East Street]

A City guard, his uniform in perfect order, stands proudly beside the large gate.

On occasion a glimpse of light flashes from the south, but either direction on the barely discernible path remains dark.

[Lightning Forest]

Poking their head out of the dead trees, mushrooms grow plentiful in a myriad of different shapes, colors, and sizes.

[Lightning Forest]
Brightly colored mushrooms dot the burned out tree trunks. Insects diligently go about their business, attempting to weave in and out of the mushroom city. High above birds chirp in anger at having their home disturbed by those who pass through here. Occasionally one of the braver females will land and quickly pull a worm out of the moist ground to take back to her babies.

The area is illuminated.

[Urda Town Square Center]
The former site of a fierce battle for control of this great city was waged here, and on this site is where it's citizens celebrate that victory. Statues of the fallen heroes, and great leaders of the alliance adorn the tops of grand marble archways leading in all directions. They stand ever vigilant against any unseen enemy. The people of Urda flock here to barter and trade, to converse with friends, or just relax near the fountain and have a game of chess. Benches and tables dot the landscape near the edge of the fountain. Hawkers of all type roll through this area with their wares, hoping to make a few coins. Languages of all races are spoken here. The sheer din of the crowd reverberates throughout the area. Passersby stop to admire the detail of the arches as they enter and exit the city square.

The area is illuminated.

Benches and tables dot the landscape near the edge of the fountain. Hawkers of all type roll through this area with their wares, hoping to make a few coins. Languages of all races are spoken here. The sheer din of the crowd reverberates throughout the area. Passersby stop to admire the detail of the arches as they enter and exit the city square.

The area is illuminated.

[Urda Town Square Center]
The former site of a fierce battle for control of this great city was waged here, and on this site is where it's citizens celebrate that victory. Statues of the fallen heroes, and great leaders of the alliance adorn the tops of grand marble archways leading in all directions. They stand ever vigilant against any unseen enemy. The people of Urda flock here to barter and trade, to converse with friends, or just relax near the fountain and have a game of chess. Benches and tables dot the landscape near the edge of the fountain. Hawkers of all type roll through this area with their wares, hoping to make a few coins. Languages of all races are spoken here. The sheer din of the crowd reverberates throughout the area. Passersby stop to admire the detail of the arches as they enter and exit the city square.

The area is illuminated.

The people of Urda flock here to barter and trade, to converse with friends, or just relax near the fountain and have a game of chess. Benches and tables dot the landscape near the edge of the fountain. Hawkers of all type roll through this area with their wares, hoping to make a few coins. Languages of all races are spoken here. The sheer din of the crowd reverberates throughout the area. Passersby stop to admire the detail of the arches as they enter and exit the city square.

The area is illuminated.

[Travers Town Square]
Small marble benches are scattered neatly about the square welcoming travelers to take a seat or to possibly empty pebbles from their boots. Cobblestone streets decorate the square alternating from browns to reds in a random pattern. Small statues of the world's races stand behind each bench as if standing sentinel. Tall lamp posts with wrought iron lanterns look down on the neat and clean streets. An occasional waste engineer wanders through, sweeping up dirt and trash into tin dustpans. Tucked away in a corner is an old door leading to a rundown store. The loud echoing of dripping water can be heard coming from a metal grate which is recessed into the street.

The area is illuminated.
